title: Tokyopop Announces 7 New Manga Licenses Including Garagarapon
content:
Tokyopop announced at Anime NYC on Friday it has licensed seven new manga. The company stated all the below titles are all scheduled for a release in 2027.

The new licenses include:

A peculiar roof-top amusement park. A stone monument by the mountain road. A 23 minute and 45 second film. A guide for cultivating plants. The corpse of a ghost. The sounds echoing through an elevator.

Each story peeks through a veil, descending into the next, evoking the most primal human fear… Death.

title: Fate/strange Fake TV Anime Confirms New Season
content:
Aniplex confirmed in a video on Saturday that the Fate/strange Fake television anime will get a new season. The company first announced the news at a panel for the anime at the Anime NYC event on Friday.

Aniplex had teased a "To be continued" message in a video for the anime it released after the anime's 13th episode aired in March.

The anime adapts Ryohgo Narita 's Fate/strange Fake spinoff story.

The first season debuted on January 3 at 11:30 p.m. on Tokyo MX , BS11 , Gunma TV , and Tochigi TV . The first airing was for 90 minutes, airing both the Fate/strange Fake -Whispers of Dawn- special and then the first episode of the main television anime series.

The anime was previously slated to premiere in 2025. Crunchyroll is streaming the series in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, and CIS.

The English-subbed version of the anime's first episode debuted at the "Fate 20th Anniversary Showcase" event in November 2024. Crunchyroll debuted the anime's Japanese-dubbed version in December 2024. It began streaming the English dub of the anime in January 2026.

Fate/strange Fake -Whispers of Dawn- directors Shun Enokido ( Fate/Grand Order commercials, Flip Flappers episode director) and Takahito Sakazume ( Fate/Grand Order commercials Fate/Apocrypha episode director) directed the Fate/strange Fake anime at A-1 Pictures . Daisuke Daitō ( Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 , More Than a Married Couple, But Not Lovers ) wrote the scripts. Yūkei Yamada ( Fate/Apocrypha ) designed the characters and was also the chief animation director, and Hiroyuki Sawano ( Attack on Titan , Mobile Suit Gundam UC ) composed the music.

SawanoHiroyuki[nZk]: Jean-Ken Johnny & TAKUMA performed the opening theme song "Provant."

The earlier Fate/strange Fake -Whispers of Dawn- anime special premiered in Japan in July 2023. The special is available on Crunchyroll with an English dub.

Narita ( Baccano! , Durarara!! ) first published the Fake/states night story as an April Fool's joke in April 1, 2008. Narita then developed the story as a Fate/strange Fake supplement for the Type-Moon Ace Vol. 2 magazine, before launching a full-fledged light novel series with illustrations by Shizuki Morii in January 2015. Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko imprint published the ninth light novel volume in March 2024. The 10th and final volume of the novels will ship this summer.

Morii has also been simultaneously drawing a manga adaptation.

title: 'Fate/strange Fake' New Season Announced
content:
The Fate/strange Fake stage at Anime NYC 2026 announced that a new season is in production and revealed a teaser visual (pictured) on Friday.

A-1 Pictures produced an anime special , subtitled as Whispers of Dawn aired in July 2023 at Anime Expo 2023, followed by the first season airing in Winter 2026. Crunchyroll simulcasted the anime with multiple subtitles and an English dub.

The text— Fake/states night —was originally placed as an April Fools joke on Narita's homepage, presented as a prologue and introduction to a role-playing game. The second volume of TYPE-MOON Ace reissued it as a stand-alone novel form under the title Fate/strange Fake in January 2009.

Kadokawa began publishing it through its Dengeki Bunko imprint in January 2015, featuring illustrations by Shizuki Morii ( Fate/Grand Order: Zettai Majuu Sensen Babylonia ). The ninth volume went on sale in March 2024.

Type-Moon concurrently began releasing a manga adaptation by Narita and Morii digitally under its Type-Moon Books imprint the same month as the light novel, with Kadokawa publishing the print version. The fifth volume also shipped in February 2022.

title: 3 Reasons Solo Leveling Is Far Better Than Haters Give It Credit For
content:
Even before the anime debuted in 2024, Solo Leveling was globally popular thanks to the exceptional story by Chugong. The light novel and the webtoon’s success made it possible for the anime adaptation to reach new heights of popularity. While the main story is already over, the anime still has a huge chunk of story left to adapt. The second season was released in Winter 2025, and the animation stayed silent on the sequel for over a year. Now that it’s confirmed that the anime is returning with a feature-length film , fans are all the more excited to see Jinwoo continue his journey. However, just as many fans the series has, the number of haters is nothing to be ignored.

The series is often criticized for being overrated for not having a lot of character depth, among many other things. For a series as popular as Solo Leveling , it receives just as much hate for always being in the limelight. Although it’s completely subjective to like or hate the series, it does have a few strong points that made it so popular. While Solo Leveling is far from the best series , it’s not nearly as bad as many would claim it to be.

3) Solo Leveling Isn’t Complex, And It Doesn’t Try to Be

Solo Leveling ‘s strength lies in a straightforward story with lots of action, the protagonist’s power-up, and the layers of mysteries. However, the series is a simplistic portrayal of an urban fantasy that doesn’t try to appear too deep or complex. It’s the kind of show you read or watch for fun without thinking too deeply about the state of the world and the side characters.

Many would prefer the story wouldn’t be like that, but that’s what makes it a fun read altogether. Solo Leveling is fast-paced, which is exactly what you’d expect from a story that doesn’t delve too deep into political drama. However, that doesn’t mean it completely neglects everything that’s been happening to those around Jinwoo. Instead of focusing on heavy lore, it relies on methodical progression to help Jinwoo reach the top as soon as possible.

2) The Fight Scenes Are Intense and Often Unmatched

The only quality that sets Solo Leveling apart from other series is the level of hype battles Jinwoo has fought throughout his journey. As an action series, it nails the fight choreography even in manhwa thanks to the incredible illustrations by DUBU. However, the animation elevates even further, relying on the series’ biggest strength more than anything. It’s no wonder Solo Leveling is the best when it comes to webtoon adaptations, and it’s easily the best series from A-1 Pictures studio.

The fights are a huge part of the story, and they continue to get more intense as Jinwoo keeps leveling up. Starting with ordinary dungeon monsters and B-Rank Hunters, Jinwoo eventually became powerful enough to clear an S-Rank dungeon all by himself . However, even the finale of Season 2 isn’t the peak of his powers, and there are more surprises waiting for fans in the anime.

1) Solo Leveling ‘s World-Building Is Often Overlooked

Not many fans or even haters talk about it, but Solo Leveling ‘s world-building is one of the best in the webtoon industry. The story is set in an urban fantasy world where mysterious gates showed up out of nowhere. As if that wasn’t enough, it also blends video game rules through the system, which is directly tied to the secrets of the world. While the main story itself takes place in a realistic setting, Jinwoo often travels through dimensions to power up.

Not only that, but the story keeps getting better as Jinwoo gets closer to the truth. After he uncovers the secret about the System, he also learns about the Cosmic beings and the historic world where he has been forced to take part. The story features the world through his lens and doesn’t hold back in the juxtaposition of the modern setting and the alternate fantasy realms that are directly tied to it.

title: Kodansha USA Licenses Trapped on Tape!, Announces Print Release for Hajime no Ippo: Fighting Spirit! Manga
content:
Kodansha USA Publishing announced during its panel at Anime NYC on Friday new manga releases for its Kodansha Print Club as well as one horror license. The company also announced an omnibus print release for the long-running series Hajime no Ippo: Fighting Spirit! , which Kodansha 's K MANGA service has been releasing digitally in English.

For the first time in print in English, experience the beginning of the epic sports manga that defined a generation and has sold more than 100 million copies worldwide, inspiring multiple hit anime series! Each premium paperback will include the content of 3 Japanese volumes.

The new horror license is:

This "ancient" technology sets Jun on a quest to dispel the ghosts haunting the countryside, but is this too much for one little girl, even with her new pal and trusty pup by her side? And why did her father move them to the country in the first place? New friends, old secrets, and ghostly terror combine for a languid summer horror unlike any other…!

TNSK depicts Jun's slow, quiet rural life in gorgeous detail, blending sweetness, humor, terror, and the joy of discovery with unique character designs and rich characterization. The cute art/dark content combo evokes series like Made in Abyss , and thanks to movies like The Ring and V/H/S, the very image of a video cassette conjures terrifying associations! Throw in a dash of Spirited Away , and Trapped on Tape! might just be the eerie, adorable new series you've been looking for!

New Kodansha Print Club releases include:

Turn up the steam in this sporty, high-school romcom between a sharp-tongued girl who swears she hates jocks and the single-minded, loyal karate champ who loves her. A little spicy, a little protective, Abe-kun will get you, too!

Horror, absurdity, and passionate romance abound in this life-or-death hit manga about love between a high schooler and her ghostly boyfriend.

The prodigal daughter returns to a tempest in the tea fields in this fake-marriage, found-family love story for the ages! By the illustrator of the Ossan's "LOVe" manga adaptation!

title: Fate/strange Fake New Anime Season Announced With Teaser Visual
content:
A new Fate/strange Fake anime series has officially been announced, with a teaser visual and the words “New Season Confirmed.” The announcement from the anime’s official account describes the project as a “new series,” while the newly released English-language visual specifically states “New Season Confirmed.”

The anime released Episode 1 titled “The Heroic Spirit Incident” in Japan and worldwide on December 31, 2024 ahead of its regular release, which began in January 2026. The first season ran for a total of 13 episodes, with A-1 Pictures handling the animation. The final episode ended with the words “to be continued.” The new teaser visual teases with the words “Rise Against the Rules” and “New Season Confirmed.” You can check it out below.

The anime continued after the events of Fate/strange Fake: Whispers of Dawn , the 1-hour TV special that was released on July 2, 2023. The staff for the anime includes:

• Original Story: Ryohgo Narita, TYPE-MOON

• Original Character Design: Shizuki Morii

• Directors: Shun Enokido, Takahito Sakazume

• Screenplay: Daisuke Ohigashi

• Character Design & Chief Animation Director: Yukei Yamada

• Art Director: Ayu Seiki

• Color Setting: Takahiro Mogi

• CG Director: Shinichi Miyakaze (GRAPHINICA)

• Director of Photography: Yohei Miyawaki

• Editing: Yuji Kondo (REAL-T)

• Sound Director: Masaki Tsuchiya

• Sound Effects: Yasumasa Koyama

• Music: Hiroyuki Sawano

• Animation Production: A-1 Pictures

As for the voice cast of Fate/strange Fake , it consists of the following members:

• Kana Hanazawa as Ayaka Sajo

• Yuki Ono as Saber

• Sumire Morohoshi as Tiné Chelc

• Tomokazu Seki as Archer

• Yu Kobayashi as Lancer

• Aoi Koga as Tsubaki Kuruoka

• Wataru Hatano as Orlando Reeve

• Showtaro Morikubo as Caster

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Flat Escardos

• Kenyu Horiuchi as Berserker

• Tatsumaru Tachibana as Jester Karture

• Lynn as Assassin

• Maaya Uchida as Francesca Prelati

• Junya Enoki as Faldeus Dioland

• Daisuke Namikawa as Lord El-Melloi II

• Shunsuke Sakuya as Langal

Fate/strange Fake is based on the light novel series written by Ryohgo Narita and illustrated by Shizuki Morii. The story follows an irregular Holy Grail War taking place in Snowfield, Nevada, where an attempted recreation of the ritual leads to a conflict that differs significantly from a traditional Holy Grail War.

title: Omoi Licenses Love Is the Sweetest Journey Manga, Adds Titan Manga Titles
content:
Digital manga publisher Omoi announced on Friday during its panel at Anime NYC that it has licensed Momoshiro and Tomoko Mitsuki's Love Is the Sweetest Journey ( Tabi wa Ui Mono Amai Mono ) manga, and will begin releasing English chapters in 2027. Omoi describes the manga:

Suzune was just about to turn 30 when her boyfriend of three years dumped her, and admitted he had been cheating the whole time! Furious and depressed, she heads to Miyazaki Prefecture to cleanse her soul while filming videos for her travel-themed social channel. There she meets Yuujin, a mysterious young novelist struggling with writer's block. After a drunken night together, Yuujin realizes Suzune might be just the inspiration he needs, and asks her an unexpected question: “will you travel with me?” A delightfully sweet romantic travelogue about discovering new places together, featuring real locations throughout Japan!

Momoshiro and Mitsuki launched the manga on Bungeishunju 's Seasons manga website in 2023, and ended it on February 20. Bungeishunju published the manga's sixth and final compiled book volume on April 16. Momoshiro wrote the manga's story, and Mitsuki drew the art.

In addition, Omoi announced that Scholastic 's Graphix imprint will begin releasing artist Tawa Akeno , author Tsukasa Mikuni , and character designer Sochu's A Snow Fox at the Northern Fort ( Kita no Toride nite ) manga in black-and-white print editions in fall 2027. Omoi licensed the manga in June earlier this year, and is releasing chapters weekly.

Omoi also revealed that it will add 45 titles from Titan Manga in the coming weeks. Volumes from SANDA , Record Journey , and The Elegant Courtly Life of the Tea Witch are all available today, with the full catalog available later. The titles will be available to Omoi Premium subscribers, and volumes can also be purchased separately.

Omoi will also add Banjo Saitou's Vegetable Sandwich manga from Manga Mavericks Books . The title will be available for Omoi Premium subscribers on September 29. Manga Mavericks Books licensed the manga in January earlier this year.

Omoi (then Azuki ) launched in June 2021 on iOS, Android, and web browser in English worldwide except Japan. The service offers simulpub manga chapters shortly after they launch in Japan in addition to a library of other titles. Omoi 's first partnership was with Kodansha USA , and the service offered titles from the publisher's catalog at launch, until Kodansha ended simulpub manga distribution with the company and on other platforms in January 2023.

Omoi changed its name from Azuki in November 2025.

In addition, Omoi announced that Scholastic 's Graphix imprint will begin releasing artist Tawa Akeno , author Tsukasa Mikuni , and character designer Sochu's A Snow Fox at the Northern Fort ( Kita no Toride nite ) manga in black-and-white print editions in fall 2027. Omoi licensed the manga in June earlier this year, and is releasing chapters weekly.

Omoi also revealed that it will add 45 titles from Titan Manga in the coming weeks. Volumes from SANDA , Record Journey , and The Elegant Courtly Life of the Tea Witch are all available today, with the full catalog available later. The titles will be available to Omoi Premium subscribers, and volumes can also be purchased separately.

Omoi will also add Banjo Saitou's Vegetable Sandwich manga from Manga Mavericks Books . The title will be available for Omoi Premium subscribers on September 29. Manga Mavericks Books licensed the manga in January earlier this year.

Omoi (then Azuki ) launched in June 2021 on iOS, Android, and web browser in English worldwide except Japan. The service offers simulpub manga chapters shortly after they launch in Japan in addition to a library of other titles. Omoi 's first partnership was with Kodansha USA , and the service offered titles from the publisher's catalog at launch, until Kodansha ended simulpub manga distribution with the company and on other platforms in January 2023.
Omoi changed its name from Azuki in November 2025.

title: 1 Year Later, Spy x Family Finally Debunks The Main Villain’s Power With a Major Twist
content:
It’s been over a year since Spy x Family released Chapter 109, which shook the fandom with Melinda Desmond’s confession. After learning that Melinda is struggling with family issues, Yor suggested that she consult Loid Forger as his patient. However, fans never expected Melinda to reveal that not only can Donovan Desmond read people’s minds, but she also believes he is an alien. She believes her husband changed completely around the time her sons were born, but doesn’t exactly remember the details. However, Melinda is sure that her real husband is somewhere else in space while an alien has inhabited his body.

While Loid didn’t take her seriously, Anya, who is also a telepath, believed there must be some truth to this. Donovan is the primary target of WISE, and he’s also the reason why Loid was assigned to Operation Strix in the first place. As the leader of the National Unity Party, he is the prime suspect of being a warmonger. However, even though it’s been seven years since the manga’s debut, Donovan is still shrouded in mystery. While the manga hasn’t revealed much about him, the latest Chapter 139 Part 2 debunks the alien theory altogether.

Spy x Family Reveals Donovan Desmond Isn’t an Alien

The alien theory always sounded unbelievable to begin with, but the manga already confirmed that he’s just an ordinary human. Or at least, that’s what he wants others to believe. In Chapter 139 Part 2, Anya got close enough to him so she could read his mind. His words were incoherent, making it impossible for Anya to understand what he really meant. However, she realized that not only is Donovan a human, but he also doesn’t have telepathic powers.

This doesn’t mean he is ordinary by any means, since his thoughts about a certain research made Anya remember the horrible days she spent as a test subject. She even went to sleep with Yor since she was unable to sleep after that one-sided encounter. Not only that, but the scars on Donovan’s head also imply he could be a test subject as well. Whether he did it voluntarily or was forced to, he is still somehow connected to what happened to Anya in the past.

Anya wasn’t born with telepathic powers , but she was created in that way so she could prove to be useful to Ostania. As someone of his status, Donovan is aware of many things happening around him. He is hiding everything about himself from his wife and lives as a recluse so people wouldn’t learn his secret. As for what the secret is, the series might take a few months or even longer to reveal more about him.

title: 38 Years Later, Dragon Ball Is Due Yet Another Backstory For Vegeta With Manga’s Return
content:
Dragon Ball Super revived the series after two decades when Akira Toriyama returned with a brand new story for fans. While Toriyama served as the writer of the new manga, Toyotaro continued working with him as the illustrator. The series takes place not long after the Majin Buu Saga, focusing on the lives of Goku, his family, and the Z Fighters. This also includes Vegeta, who has changed significantly after the main story. Vegeta was introduced in the manga 38 years ago in Chapter 204 of the Saiyan Saga. While he was initially introduced as a major villain, he went through countless trials and tribulations to become the person he is today. The series also revealed everything he had to suffer because of Frieza.

Vegeta’s character development happened throughout the course of the story. Instead of turning him into a completely different person overnight, Toriyama ensured that his progress would seem even more fulfilling. The main story already introduced his father, the proud King Vegeta, who had no choice but to bow to Frieza if he wanted his planet to survive. Although it’s believed his mother is also dead, the series never revealed anything about her, not even her face. However, after the latest official alternate cover by Toyotaro , it’s more evident than ever that Dragon Ball Super needs to explore more about his past.

Vegeta Needs Another Backstory After The Alternate Cover of Dragon Ball Super

The cover shows the first glimpse of Vegeta’s mother in 38 years after his introduction. While it doesn’t actually reveal her face, fans do get confirmation that she was alive around the time Vegeta and his brother were kids. His mother is still a mystery to fans, but this first glimpse clearly points towards a possibility of another backstory. Toyotaro also confirmed that the idea of introducing Vegeta’s mother came to his mind suddenly.

This could also mean that fans might know more about her and Vegeta’s childhood if Dragon Ball Super returns. This wouldn’t only add more character depth to the Saiyan Prince, but also answer several questions about his mother. The manga has been on an indefinite hiatus since Toriyama’s death in March 2024. In February next year, Toyotaro returned with a special chapter before taking another long break.

The artist will be taking over the helm in both art and story, and he clearly has big shoes to fill. The long hiatus is reasonable considering the pressure he has been facing to live up to fans’ expectations. While the manga doesn’t have a return date yet, Toyotaro has already confirmed he will be returning with the manga . While fans await the manga’s return, Dragon Ball Super will be continuing the story in the Galactic Patrol anime, which will continue the story after the Tournament of Power Arc.

title: Chainsaw Man Creator Breaks Silence on Acclaimed One-Shot’s Live-Action
content:
Tatsuki Fujimoto is one of the most celebrated manga creators in recent years. While he is best known for Chainsaw Man , he has also created Fire Punch and several acclaimed one-shots. One of his one-shots, Look Back , gained worldwide recognition in 2024 after its anime adaptation. The award-winning film became a global hit as it follows a heartbreaking story of two aspiring manga creators. Produced by Studio DURIAN, the gorgeous anime was praised for its nuanced story with emotional moments. Following the anime film’s success, a live-action adaptation was also confirmed . The film will hit Japanese theatres on September 11th, 2026, but hasn’t confirmed a global release date yet.

However, GKIDS will be bringing the live-action film to fans in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Ireland soon after. The film is already making waves thanks to its excellent cast and crew, especially Hirokazu Kore-eda, Palme d’Or winner and Oscar-nominated filmmaker, best known for Shoplifters . He is serving as the writer, editor, and director of the film. As the release date of the film draws near, Fujimoto got early access, and he’s more than impressed by the adaptation.

Tatsuki Fujimoto Praises Look Back Live-Action Film

According to Oricon , Fujimoto shared, “I was very happy because, without losing the tone of the original manga, the film was able to bring out the atmosphere that the original had while giving it a real sense of authenticity.”

Live-action adaptations are infamous for straying away from the original source, often leading to criticisms and fans’ complaints. While live-actions often take creative liberties with the original story, they are not always the best way to go about the story. Even a well-received adaptation like One Piece wasn’t exempt from that, and the number of changes made by Netflix is astounding.

However, while One Piece became a massive global hit, not many live-action adaptations become famous for the very same reason. Considering many such cases, Look Back is surely an exception for following the original tone of the manga as much as possible. While Fujimoto praises the film, he also implies that the film will have changes from the original source. Regardless, now that the creator has given it his approval, it’s all the more reason to look forward to it.

Look Back Is Getting a New Home Video Release in September

Last month, GKIDS also confirmed that the anime film will release a 4K UHD Collector’s Edition . While it’s already available for pre-order on the official website of GKIDS, the home video will be released on September 8th, 2026. It’s available in both Japanese and English audio with subtitles in multiple languages, including English, Spanish, and French. Fans will also get several exciting bonuses such as an interview with the director and cast members, a 160-page book, and more. Even though two years have passed since the film’s debut, it continues to stay in the spotlight thanks to these new releases.
